player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Your symbol is '{symbol}'.
The goal is to avoid getting three in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally).
If you make three in a row, you LOSE.
Submit your move using the format '[4]' to place your symbol in cell 4.
As Player {player_id}, you are '{symbol}' and your opponent is '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A yeke na lege ni pëpe ti zia zo. Sara kua na "[cell]".
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Index ti acellule so ayeke na lege ni ape.
invalid_move.already_occupied: A zia mbeni tënë na yâ ti cellule {cell} awe.

game_action.placed: Wë̈t ë pɛ̈i {player_id} acë käkä ({symbol}) ë bë̈n ë pɛ̈nɛ̈ {cell}.

outcome.loss: Zo ti pikango ye {player_id} ayeke girisa na lege so lo hunzi mbeni molongo!
outcome.draw: A yeke gï tongana zo oko atumba pëpe.
